# اُسْتُدْرِجَا (ustudrijā) /us.tud.ri.d͡ʒaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَدْرَجَ (istadraja)
# اِسْتَدْرِجَا (istadrijā) /is.tad.ri.d͡ʒaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَدْرَجَ (istadraja)
